label: Kuala Lumpur
short_description: Loyalty-program hotels across Kuala Lumpur, from KLCC skyline towers to Bukit Bintang and KL Sentral.
intro: Kuala Lumpur's hotels in this directory are concentrated around KLCC and the Petronas Towers, the Bukit Bintang shopping and nightlife district, and the KL Sentral transit hub used for KLIA Ekspres airport transfers. Most of the city's major sights and malls are within a short drive or LRT ride of these clusters.
